name: Spinner
summary: Pure CSS rotating-arc loading indicator. Determinate state lives in Progress. Use Spinner ONLY for indeterminate, ≤ 5 s loads — past 5 s upgrade to Progress with a label that names what you're waiting on. Three tones (default, accent, on-action) and four sizes. Inline (icon-button leading) and standalone.

size.description: xs=12 / sm=14 / md=16 / lg=20 px outer diameter.

tone.description: default: text.primary stroke. accent: text.accent (e.g. live feed). on-action: text-on-accent (inside a primary CTA when loading=true). subtle: text.tertiary (background tasks).

label.description: aria-label override. Defaults to 'Loading' when no visible label is rendered nearby.

inline.description: Pairs with an adjacent label — 'Loading transactions…' style. Use inline=false for standalone (centered in a Card body).

rules: role='status' so SR announces the loading state via aria-live='polite' (Radix Status / sr-only label).
When the Spinner appears next to visible loading text, aria-hidden the spinner and let the text carry the message.
Spin animation is paused under prefers-reduced-motion (animation: none); the spinner falls back to a dim ring + an sr-only label.
Stroke color must clear 3:1 against the surface — default text.primary on canvas is 15:1 (AAA), accent on canvas is 10:1 (AAA), subtle on canvas is 3.7:1 (AA Large).

do: Use Spinner for indeterminate loads ≤ 5 s.
Pair with adjacent text when the load is more than a single icon-button interaction.
Use tone='accent' inside Live feeds where the spinner aligns with the freshness signal.
Use tone='on-action' inside a primary Button when loading=true (the parent Button manages this automatically).
dont: Don't use Spinner past 5 s — upgrade to Progress with a label.
Don't use Spinner inline with form-row validation. Inline form load uses Skeleton or a small Progress.
Don't paint the Spinner stroke in a non-token color.
Don't render multiple Spinners simultaneously on one surface — pick the most representative location.

changelog.note: Initial Spinner contract. Pure CSS rotating arc. Four sizes, four tones. prefers-reduced-motion pause.
